config.label: API key from https://dashboard
config.description: API key from https://dashboard.voidmob.com/developers/api-keys (vmk_live_...). Needed for real purchases; without it tools are listed but every call returns setup instructions.

config.label: Set to 1 to use offline mock data with a $500 play balance instead of the live API (no key needed, nothing is charged)
config.description: Set to 1 to use offline mock data with a $500 play balance instead of the live API (no key needed, nothing is charged).

config.label: Set to 1 to hide every tool that spends money or changes anything (searches and reads stay available)
config.description: Set to 1 to hide every tool that spends money or changes anything (searches and reads stay available).

config.label: Refuse any single purchase, renewal or top-up whose max price is above this many US cents (e
config.description: Refuse any single purchase, renewal or top-up whose max price is above this many US cents (e.g. 2500 = $25).

config.label: Spending limit in US cents for this server process (a per-session safety net, not an account limit); purchases that would exceed it, and turning on auto-renew, are refused
config.description: Spending limit in US cents for this server process (a per-session safety net, not an account limit); purchases that would exceed it, and turning on auto-renew, are refused.

config.label: Set to 1 to let the agent buy without asking first, within the limits
config.description: Set to 1 to let the agent buy without asking first, within the limits. Needs VOIDMOB_BUDGET_CENTS or a daily limit on the API key; every limit still applies.

config.label: Comma list of tool groups to load: sms, numbers, esim, proxy (account, deposit, orders and geo tools are always on)
config.description: Comma list of tool groups to load: sms, numbers, esim, proxy (account, deposit, orders and geo tools are always on). Default: all.
